tool.name: Skyline alkane QC
tool.description: calculate mass accuracy and retention time deviation from a Skyline report
tool.command: MPLBACKEND=Agg python3 '$__tool_directory__/skyline_alkane_qc.py' --input '$input' --summary summary.csv --mass_plot mass_accuracy.png --rt_plot retention_time.png --deviation_plot rt_deviation.png

param.name: input
param.label: Skyline report
param.help: Report with File Name, Molecule Name, Mass Error PPM, and Retention Time columns.

tool.help:
This tool processes a Skyline alkane report containing **File Name**, **Molecule Name**, **Mass Error PPM**, and **Retention Time** columns.
It produces a CSV summary with the largest absolute mass error (ppm) and the largest per-alkane retention time range (seconds), plus plots of absolute mass error and retention time across samples and a bar plot of retention time range for each alkane. Retention times in the input are assumed to be in minutes. Sample names beginning with a number are ordered by that number. Molecules retain the order in which they first appear in the input report.
